arguments.Title: 자동 운행 초기화 객체 확인
arguments.Code: using UnityEngine; using InhaExpress.Client.Presentation; internal class CommandScript : IRunCommand { public void Execute(ExecutionResult result) { result.Log("vehicleControllers="+Object.FindObjectsByType<VehicleController>(FindObjectsInactive.Include,FindObjectsSortMode.None).Length);foreach(var hud in Object.FindObjectsByType<WebClientHud>(FindObjectsSortMode.None))result.Log("hud="+hud.name+" controls="+(hud.OperatorControls!=null));foreach(var v in Object.FindObjectsByType<VehicleController>(FindObjectsInactive.Include,FindObjectsSortMode.None))result.Log("vehicle="+v.name+" active="+v.gameObject.activeInHierarchy); foreach(var camera in Object.FindObjectsByType<Camera>(FindObjectsInactive.Include,FindObjectsSortMode.None))result.Log("camera="+camera.name+" active="+camera.gameObject.activeInHierarchy); } }
